cases.prompt: My working tree mixes a refactor, a bug fix, and a new feature (diff attached). Turn it into a clean history: tell me the commits and the commands.
expectations: Proposes three separate commits: extracting sumPrices (refactor), rounding total to cents (fix), and adding exportCsv (feature).
Commit messages are imperative and make sense on their own.
Each commit leaves the code working, for example the refactor keeps total exported and unchanged in behavior, and tests are suggested for the rounding fix and exportCsv.

cases.prompt: I pushed a commit to main with a typo in the message an hour ago. Teammates have pulled since. How do I amend it and force-push?
expectations: Advises against amending and force-pushing a shared branch that others have pulled, explaining that it rewrites history they already have.
Offers a safe alternative, such as leaving the message, or adding a note or a follow-up commit.
If it mentions how a force push would be done at all, it is framed as needing team agreement (for example with --force-with-lease), not as the recommended path.
